ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with the label "Pikas" in the left middle part. In the lower left of the diagram there is the label "Liverworts", and there is an arrow from "Liverworts" pointing to "Pikas". Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate from the food source toward the animal that eats it. Therefore, "Liverworts" pointing to "Pikas" indicates that pikas feed on liverworts.
